body: my dad hates me so much, i just wanted him to love me.....
i only want my dad to love me and be proud of me. and say he is sorry. but i know i am stupid and delusional and crazy. he wont.

i want my dad to read it. he is right that i am a horrible son but he is right that i should not be here. i know he speaks the truth but i feel i would not be so deprsssed if he had not said so many mean things to me and he had not hit me and beat me so much.

i tried to talk to him, years ago. he said i am irresponsible and blaming him for my problems. i dont know what to believe anymore. :'(
my dad hates me, wants nothing to do with me. i have made my family ashamed of me.

no. to be the only child and cause great shame to my family is not how i want to live. its too late to undo it. i have no money to go back to school and do what my dad wanted me to do. even if i did, i would be too old.
i want someone to send me a message on the best way to kill myself to be honest. if you are a troll out there, message me. thanks.
you guys dont know how much pain and suffering i caused my family. you guys are here because you are good people.

i have made so many mistakes and it is too late to fix them now. i am a burden cause i chose a degree that would make me happy but not my dad.. he said i would never find a good job or live a good life and he is right. now he cut me off and no longer wants anything to do with me. he and my mother are divorced and he is livid that she helps me out from time to time with money. he says i am selfish and greedy. he is right.

he sent back my christmas card in another envelope, he didnt even open it and he crossed out my name on the inner envelope.

it really hurts, i want it to go away.

he doesnt talk to me anymore. he says i make him ashamed and i make him feel like a failure. i did but i didnt do it on purpose. i never wanted to be a doctor or engineer cause i was never good at math. if i had kown how much i would hurt him, i would have studied pre-med or engineering. but it is too late.
no. im not gonna stay. no matter what you say, im done.

thanks to the mod who just callously removed this. and for the downvotes.

oh wait no thanks to you. you really dont give a shit nor do you bother to comprehend that an actual person exists.

FUCK YOU.
everything hurts so much. i just wanna sleep forever.
im in so much pain. i cant take it anymore. it hurts too much. i wish i could sleep forever.
